evals.name: rigol-dp832-bench-psu
evals.prompt: Create a ComPort Zone control panel JSON for a Rigol DP832 triple-output bench supply. I only care about channel 1 for now. Commands: '*IDN?' for identity, ':MEAS:VOLT? CH1' for live voltage, ':MEAS:CURR? CH1' for current, ':MEAS:POWE? CH1' for power, ':SOUR1:VOLT <v>' to set voltage (0..30 V, 1 mV step), ':SOUR1:CURR <i>' to set current limit (0..3 A, 1 mA step), ':OUTP CH1,ON' / ':OUTP CH1,OFF' for output, ':OUTP? CH1' returns 'ON' or 'OFF'.

evals.name: keysight-34461a-dmm-statreg
evals.prompt: Keysight 34461A DMM panel: identity on connect, live READ?, and a bits tile decoding STAT:QUES:COND? — bit 0 Voltage out-of-range (fail), bit 1 Current out-of-range (fail), bit 4 Temperature (warn), bit 8 Calibration error (fail), bit 9 Self-test failed (fail).
